title: Projection-Free Multi-level Algorithms for Stochastic Constrained Compositional Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.15679v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper studies projection-free algorithms for stochastic constrained multi-level compositional optimization. In this context, the objective function is a nested composition of several smooth functions, and the decision set is closed and convex. Since projection onto the constraint set can be computationally expensive, we develop projection-free methods that rely on linear minimization oracles. For non-convex objectives, we propose variance-reduced projection-free algorithms and establish complexity guarantees under both the Frank-Wolfe gap and the gradient mapping criteria. We also develop momentum-based methods that achieve convergence guarantees under weaker smoothness assumptions. Additionally, by using a stage-wise design, we derive a parameter-free variant that preserves the same complexities for the Frank-Wolfe gap. translated_title: 随机约束复合优化的免投影多层算法
translated_abstract: 本文研究随机约束多层复合优化的免投影算法。在此背景下，目标函数是多个光滑函数的嵌套复合，决策集为闭凸集。由于向约束集投影的计算代价可能很高，我们开发了依赖于线性最小化预言机的免投影方法。对于非凸目标，我们提出方差缩减的免投影算法，并在Frank-Wolfe间隙和梯度映射两种准则下建立了复杂度保证。我们还开发了基于动量的方法，在更弱的光滑性假设下获得收敛保证。此外，通过采用分阶段设计，我们推导出一种无参数变体，其保持了相同的Frank-Wolfe间隙复杂度。这种设计还可以进一步用于开发针对凸函数和强凸函数的算法，其收敛速率……
tldr: 针对随机约束多层复合优化问题，该论文提出了基于线性最小化预言机的免投影方差缩减算法，在非凸、凸和强凸设置下均建立了Frank-Wolfe间隙与梯度映射准则下的复杂度保证，并提出无参数变体及更弱光滑性假设下的动量方法。
en_tdlr: This paper develops projection-free variance-reduced algorithms based on linear minimization oracles for stochastic constrained multi-level compositional optimization, establishing complexity guarantees under both Frank-Wolfe gap and gradient mapping criteria for non-convex, convex, and strongly convex settings, along with parameter-free variants and momentum-based methods under weaker smoothness assumptions.
